<function name="GetFGColor" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the foreground color of the panel.

For a <page>Label</page> or <page>RichText</page>, this is the color of its text.

<note>This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements (such as <page>DLabel</page>) and its function varies between them</note>
	</description>
	<added>2020.03.17</added>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="color" type="Color">The <page>Color</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
